fullData.title: Storm at Silver Lake
fullData.passage: Dark clouds rolled over Silver Lake, and the water was a sheet of cold glass before the tempest began. A sudden flash of lightning cut through the sky. The wind howled through the pine trees like an angry wolf guarding its den. Raindrops fell fast and hard, and the wooden dock became an ice rink under our running feet. We raced back to the cabin just as the storm roared with all its might.

instances.text: the water was a sheet of cold glass
instances.literalMeaning: The surface of the lake was very calm, flat, and smooth.
instances.explanation: This is a metaphor because it compares the water to a sheet of glass without using the words 'like' or 'as'.

instances.text: like an angry wolf guarding its den
instances.literalMeaning: The wind blew loudly, fiercely, and in a scary way.
instances.explanation: This is a simile because it compares the sound of the wind to an angry wolf using the word 'like'.

instances.text: the wooden dock became an ice rink
instances.literalMeaning: The dock became extremely slippery from the rain.
instances.explanation: This is a metaphor because it states the dock became an ice rink to show how slippery it was, without using 'like' or 'as'.
